summary: 18-year-old Nicholas Jekel of Fort Collins was reported as an overdue motorcyclist late July 10 in the area of Forest Development Road 300 and County Road 86, ~8 mi southwest of Red Feather Lakes. LCSO Emergency Services, Larimer County Search and Rescue, the LCSO Emergency Services Support group, and Poudre Valley Hospital responded; he was located early morning July 11, apparently the victim of a fatal motorcycle accident; cause under investigation.
location: Forest Development Road 300 / County Road 86, ~8 mi SW of Red Feather Lakes
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office Emergency Services; Larimer County Search and Rescue; LCSO Emergency Services Support group; Poudre Valley Hospital
notes: Date = search/report date (July 10); located early July 11. Year 2015 pinned via search-index last-updated metadata (~4080 days before 2026-09-13).
